prompt: A widget factory operates with two machines, Machine A and Machine B, for an 8-hour shift daily. Machine A produces 100 widgets per hour, and Machine B produces 120 widgets per hour. The factory's daily target production is 1600 widgets. On Monday, Machine A starts operating but breaks down exactly 3 hours into the shift. It takes 2 hours for repairs, after which Machine A resumes operation for the remainder of the 8-hour shift. Machine B operates normally for the full 8 hours. Due to the breakdown, the factory did not meet its daily target. To compensate, both machines will operate together during an overtime period immediately after the regular shift, producing at their normal rates. How many minutes of overtime are required for the factory to meet its exact daily target of 1600 widgets?
